in_sanskrit.name: दीशा
in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of wealth, prosperity, and power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dee-sha, from the Sanskrit root ‘dhi’ meaning ‘wealth, prosperity’, and ‘isha’ meaning ‘goddess, ruler’. It represents the goddess who bestows wealth, prosperity, and power upon her devotees.

in_hindi.name: दीशा
in_hindi.meaning: दिवाली के लोगों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, ‘Deesha’ is significant for the people of Diwali. It is a popular name among Hindus and holds a special place during the festive season.

in_tamil.name: தியாஷா
in_tamil.meaning: வேலை, வழிவுக்கள், மக்கள் அவர்களிடம் வாழ்வதில்லையாக விஜயத்தினால் வருக்கின்ற வல்லவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name ‘Deesha’ is derived from the words ‘thiyam’ meaning ‘wealth’ and ‘aasham’ meaning ‘goddess’. It signifies a goddess who brings prosperity, wealth, and protection to her devotees, and is victorious over all obstacles.

in_telugu.name: దీశా
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, ‘Deesha’ is a name given to the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and power. The name is derived from the word ‘dhesham’ meaning ‘abode of the god of wealth’, and signifies the goddess who is the abode of the god of wealth and bestows blessings upon her devotees.

in_marathi.name: Deesha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess, divine power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deesha is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Desh’, meaning 'land' or 'region'. The feminine form 'Deesha' is often used to refer to a goddess or divine power. In Hindu mythology, Deesha is believed to be the divine mother of the universe, nurturing all beings and providing them with sustenance and protection.
